thread:
Ava: Quick heads-up — post-launch dashboard is showing a weird spike in inbound MQLs at ~02:00 UTC yesterday, but conversion to SQL dropped hard. Anyone else seeing this?
Diego: saw it, looks like form duplication from the webinar syndication partner? :thinking: low confidence though
Priya: pulling the UTM table now. early look shows partner sent two campaign params: 'launch_v2' and 'launch-webinar' to same LP, so our dedupe mapping didn't normalize them. pasting query:```SELECT utm_source, utm_campaign, COUNT(*) FROM marketing.form_submissions WHERE DATE(timestamp) = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20;```
Sam: dashboard filter on utm_campaign isn't deduping variants — ingestion doesn't lowercase/strip suffixes. that explains the spike and the lower CR (same users split into buckets)
dashbot: snapshot: "KPI Weekly" dashboard updated by Priya :page_facing_up:
Ellie: propose action: (1) normalize utm_campaign at ingestion (lowercase + strip non-alphanum + map variants), (2) run a rehydration to merge yesterday's duped leads, (3) add a pinned note on the dashboard about the incident.
Ben (SalesOps): rehydrate is urgent — SDRs are following up on those leads today. if we merge later they might get duped outreach. ETA?
Priya: I can push a one-off rehydrate job in ~2 hours. will output a CSV for Sales and tag merged rows with source = 'partner_syndication_normalized'. link to job once started.
Ava: 👍 please also add a dashboard annotation so the weekly report doesn't mislead execs. Diego, can you add a staging test to prevent similar UTMs slipping through?
Diego: yep. i'll add a unit test in ingestion that rejects unseen utm_campaign patterns and a small transform to normalize common variants. also adding an alert: if distinct utm_campaign count increases >50% in an hour -> notify #marketing.
Sam: should we change attribution logic? last-touch is making the webinar look worse than it is if touch splitting occurs.
Ellie: don't change attribution mid-week. we'll annotate and run a cohort analysis comparing 7d vs 30d windows and last vs first touch. report back in tomorrow's KPI review.
Priya: starting job now. CSV will be at https://bigquery.cloud.redwood/marketing/queries/12345 (read-only link). also capturing raw rows for audit.
Ava: thanks — one more ask: can SalesOps prepare a short blurb for the exec deck explaining the cause and mitigation? we want to avoid churn in perception.
Ben (SalesOps): on it. i'll draft the blurb and share in #marketing for sign-off.
Priya: job finished, merged ~1,230 duplicates, re-run of dashboard shows conversion recovered to expected baseline. pushed dashboard note and pinned it.
Ava: incredible, thanks team. post-mortem owner?
Ben (SalesOps): I'll own the post-mortem in Notion and add action items for Eng/Analytics/Marketing. pinging CS as well to surface any customer-facing noise. :eyes: :rocket:
